title: 都市空氣品質感測網~Urban air-quality sensor networks
focus: 以共置驗證、空間代表性與資料品質建立都市空氣感測網~Build an urban air-sensor network through colocation, spatial representativeness and data quality
summary: 本課以「以共置驗證、空間代表性與資料品質建立都市空氣感測網」為主軸，依序處理設站問題與空間尺度、響應曲線與校正集、平均偏差與誤差抵銷、缺值、離線與異常旗標、漂移與定期再共置。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。~This course focuses on Build an urban air-sensor network through colocation, spatial representativeness and data quality, progressing through Siting question and spatial scale, Response curve and calibration dataset, Mean bias and error cancellation, Gaps, offline periods and outlier flags, Drift and repeat colocation. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
history: 這項技術的學習脈絡由單一設備處理，逐步擴展至物質與能量收支、監測品質和生命週期比較。本課將官方方法文件作為查核入口，並以獨立編寫的假想數據練習；參考文件的年代與地區不代表其規範在所有場址適用。~The learning progression expands from individual treatment equipment to mass and energy balances, monitoring quality and lifecycle comparison. Official method documents provide verification starting points while independently authored hypothetical data support practice; a document date or jurisdiction does not establish applicability to every site.

units.title: 設站問題與空間尺度~Siting question and spatial scale
units.mechanism: 先選交通、背景或社區比較目的，再配置站點；名目站距不能代表街谷中的污染梯度。 平均面積平方根給名目站距，不能代表街谷或污染源周邊的實際解析度。~Choose traffic, background or community-comparison objectives before siting; nominal spacing does not resolve street-canyon gradients. Square root of mean area per station gives nominal spacing, not actual resolution near street canyons or sources.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：都市面積 A=36 km²；感測站 N=16。公式 s=sqrt(A/N)，計算得 1.5 km nominal spacing。適用邊界：均勻平面方格的幾何近似，不是採樣密度或法定設站建議。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Urban area A=36 km²; number of sensors N=16. Formula s=sqrt(A/N) gives 1.5 km nominal spacing. Applicability: A geometric approximation to a uniform square grid, not a station-density or regulatory siting recommendation.
units.verify: 針對「設站問題與空間尺度」，將站點疊在道路、地形與使用目的圖，檢查空間缺口及重複代表區。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Siting question and spatial scale, Overlay stations on roads, terrain and measurement objectives and check gaps and redundant representation. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 站點集中於供電方便處會留下系統性盲區。 在「設站問題與空間尺度」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Clustering stations where power is convenient creates systematic blind spots. Mark where this error can enter the Siting question and spatial scale flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 站點數量相同就保證兩座城市擁有相同空間代表性。~Equal sensor counts guarantee equal spatial representativeness in two cities.
units.practice: 只將 N 改成 36，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1.5 變成 1 km nominal spacing。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only sensor count to 36, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 1.5 to 1 km nominal spacing. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 共置與時間對齊~Colocation and time alignment
units.mechanism: 將感測器與參考儀放在可比較的位置和時段，保留時鐘、平均窗與進氣高度差異。 平均誤差描述方向性偏差；正負誤差可抵銷，因此需另報散布或 RMSE。~Colocate sensors and references comparably and retain differences in clock, averaging interval and inlet height. Mean error describes directional bias; positive and negative errors can cancel, so also report spread or RMSE.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：三個誤差值 e=[2, -1, 3] µg/m³。公式 bias=mean(e)，計算得 1.33333 µg/m³。適用邊界：配對的同時同地資料，未由三點推定完整長期性能。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Three errors e=[2, -1, 3] µg/m³. Formula bias=mean(e) gives 1.33333 µg/m³. Applicability: Paired colocated, concurrent observations; three points do not establish long-term performance.
units.verify: 針對「共置與時間對齊」，繪製誤差對濃度、濕度和時間圖，分開檢查偏差與變異。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Colocation and time alignment, Plot errors against concentration, humidity and time, examining bias separately from variability. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 平均偏差接近零仍可能有很大的正負誤差。 在「共置與時間對齊」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Near-zero mean bias can coexist with large positive and negative errors. Mark where this error can enter the Colocation and time alignment flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 平均誤差為零就表示每筆量測都完全正確。~Zero mean error means every observation is exact.
units.practice: 只把第三個誤差由 3 改為 6，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1.33333 變成 2.33333 µg/m³。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only the third error from 3 to 6, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 1.33333 to 2.33333 µg/m³. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 響應曲線與校正集~Response curve and calibration dataset
units.mechanism: 校正資料要涵蓋預期濃度範圍，分開訓練、驗證與外部測試，避免把擬合成績當泛化能力。 零點誤差與斜率誤差對不同濃度的影響不同，單點校正不能分開識別兩者。~Cover the expected concentration range and separate training, validation and external testing rather than equating fit with generalization. Offset and slope errors affect different concentrations differently; a single calibration point cannot identify both.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：參考濃度 C=50；儀器響應 y=1.08*C+2。公式 bias=y-C，計算得 6 concentration units。適用邊界：假想線性響應，濃度單位前後一致；不外推至非線性量程。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Reference concentration C=50; instrument response y=1.08*C+2. Formula bias=y-C gives 6 concentration units. Applicability: Hypothetical linear response with common concentration units; do not extrapolate into nonlinear ranges.
units.verify: 針對「響應曲線與校正集」，用空白及至少兩個非零參考點檢查殘差，保留獨立查核樣。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Response curve and calibration dataset, Use blanks and at least two nonzero references to inspect residuals, retaining an independent check standard. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 只修正零點會留下隨濃度增加的斜率偏差。 在「響應曲線與校正集」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Correcting offset alone leaves concentration-dependent slope error. Mark where this error can enter the Response curve and calibration dataset flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 零點校正正確就保證所有量程的讀值都正確。~A correct zero guarantees correct readings across the whole range.
units.practice: 只將 C 改成 100，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 6 變成 10 concentration units。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only reference C to 100, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 6 to 10 concentration units. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 濕度交互作用~Humidity interaction
units.mechanism: 追蹤光學粒子感測的濕度依賴；此虛構線性式只練習識別偏差，不能當成可下載的現場校正式。 光學粒子訊號可能受吸濕增長及粒徑組成影響；本線性式只示範環境依賴偏差。~Track humidity dependence in optical particle sensing; the invented linear equation teaches bias identification rather than supplying a field correction. Optical particle signals may respond to hygroscopic growth and size distribution; this linear equation only illustrates environment-dependent bias.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：假想粒子訊號 y=C*(1+a*RH)；真值 C=20 µg/m³；a=0.5；RH=0.60（分率）。公式 bias=C*a*RH，計算得 6 µg/m³。適用邊界：原創虛構響應係數，非任何品牌校正式，不能將此式用於實際資料修正。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Hypothetical particle signal y=C*(1+a*RH); true C=20 µg/m³; a=0.5; RH=0.60 as a fraction. Formula bias=C*a*RH gives 6 µg/m³. Applicability: An invented response coefficient, not a calibration for any brand and not for correcting real observations.
units.verify: 針對「濕度交互作用」，共置時同步量濕度，依濕度分組畫殘差，並用未訓練季節資料驗證。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Humidity interaction, Measure humidity during colocation, inspect humidity-stratified residuals and validate with an unseen season. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 只在乾燥期建立校正可能在潮濕期系統性偏高。 在「濕度交互作用」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Dry-period-only calibration can develop systematic positive bias during humid conditions. Mark where this error can enter the Humidity interaction flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 一次共置校正可永久消除所有季節與氣膠成分效應。~One colocation permanently removes all seasonal and aerosol-composition effects.
units.practice: 只將 RH 改成 0.90，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 6 變成 9 µg/m³。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only RH to 0.90, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 6 to 9 µg/m³. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 平均偏差與誤差抵銷~Mean bias and error cancellation
units.mechanism: 把高低濃度時的誤差分開畫圖；整體平均誤差接近零可能掩蓋兩端相反偏差。 平均誤差描述方向性偏差；正負誤差可抵銷，因此需另報散布或 RMSE。~Plot errors separately at low and high concentrations because near-zero overall bias can conceal opposite endpoint errors. Mean error describes directional bias; positive and negative errors can cancel, so also report spread or RMSE.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：三個誤差值 e=[2, -1, 3] µg/m³。公式 bias=mean(e)，計算得 1.33333 µg/m³。適用邊界：配對的同時同地資料，未由三點推定完整長期性能。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Three errors e=[2, -1, 3] µg/m³. Formula bias=mean(e) gives 1.33333 µg/m³. Applicability: Paired colocated, concurrent observations; three points do not establish long-term performance.
units.verify: 針對「平均偏差與誤差抵銷」，繪製誤差對濃度、濕度和時間圖，分開檢查偏差與變異。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Mean bias and error cancellation, Plot errors against concentration, humidity and time, examining bias separately from variability. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 平均偏差接近零仍可能有很大的正負誤差。 在「平均偏差與誤差抵銷」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Near-zero mean bias can coexist with large positive and negative errors. Mark where this error can enter the Mean bias and error cancellation flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 平均誤差為零就表示每筆量測都完全正確。~Zero mean error means every observation is exact.
units.practice: 只把第三個誤差由 3 改為 6，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1.33333 變成 2.33333 µg/m³。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only the third error from 3 to 6, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 1.33333 to 2.33333 µg/m³. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: RMSE 與保留資料驗證~RMSE and held-out validation
units.mechanism: 以未參與擬合的配對資料計算誤差，並同時報斜率、偏差和季節覆蓋。 RMSE 先平方再平均開根號，同時反映偏差與散布，不是標準差的同義詞。~Calculate error on held-out paired data and also report slope, bias and seasonal coverage. RMSE squares errors before averaging and taking the root; it includes bias and spread and is not synonymous with standard deviation.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：三個配對誤差 e=[2,-1,3] µg/m³。公式 RMSE=sqrt(mean(e²))，計算得 2.16025 µg/m³。適用邊界：配對樣本與相同單位；不由 RMSE 單獨判斷用途適合度。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Three paired errors e=[2,-1,3] µg/m³. Formula RMSE=sqrt(mean(e²)) gives 2.16025 µg/m³. Applicability: Paired samples in the same units; RMSE alone does not establish fitness for purpose.
units.verify: 針對「RMSE 與保留資料驗證」，與平均誤差、斜率及殘差圖一起報告，留出未擬合的資料評估。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For RMSE and held-out validation, Report it with mean bias, slope and residual plots and evaluate on held-out data. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 訓練資料上的低 RMSE 可能只是過度擬合。 在「RMSE 與保留資料驗證」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Low training RMSE may reflect overfitting. Mark where this error can enter the RMSE and held-out validation flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: RMSE 永遠等於量測誤差的標準差。~RMSE always equals the standard deviation of measurement errors.
units.practice: 只把第三個誤差改為 6，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2.16025 變成 3.69685 µg/m³。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only the third error to 6, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 2.16025 to 3.69685 µg/m³. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 缺值、離線與異常旗標~Gaps, offline periods and outlier flags
units.mechanism: 將斷電、網路、校正和真實污染尖峰分開，不能為了漂亮曲線刪除所有極端值。 完整率追蹤有效資料覆蓋；缺值可能集中在尖峰事件，不能只看比例。~Separate power loss, networking, calibration and true pollution peaks; do not delete all extremes to create a smooth curve. Completeness tracks valid coverage; gaps may cluster during peaks, so percentage alone is insufficient.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：應有時段 N=1440；有效時段 n=1320。公式 coverage=n/N*100，計算得 91.6667 %。適用邊界：明確時間格與有效性規則；本題不宣稱任何法規有效率門檻。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Expected intervals N=1440; valid intervals n=1320. Formula coverage=n/N*100 gives 91.6667 %. Applicability: Explicit interval grid and validity rules; no regulatory completeness threshold is claimed.
units.verify: 針對「缺值、離線與異常旗標」，畫出缺值時間軸並保留校正、維護與通訊錯誤旗標，禁止把缺值填成零。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Gaps, offline periods and outlier flags, Plot missing intervals with calibration, maintenance and communication flags; never replace missing values with zero. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 高污染時停機造成選擇性缺值，可偏低估平均污染。 在「缺值、離線與異常旗標」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Outages during high pollution cause selective missingness and can bias the average downward. Mark where this error can enter the Gaps, offline periods and outlier flags flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 缺測資料填成零不會影響污染平均值。~Replacing missing data with zero does not affect mean pollution.
units.practice: 只將 n 改成 1200，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 91.6667 變成 83.3333 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only valid intervals n to 1200, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 91.6667 to 83.3333 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 地圖插值與代表範圍~Mapping interpolation and representation
units.mechanism: 圖上標出站位、空白區與不確定範圍，避免把平滑插值視為每條街的實測值。 平均面積平方根給名目站距，不能代表街谷或污染源周邊的實際解析度。~Show sites, unsampled areas and uncertainty on maps rather than presenting smooth interpolation as direct measurement on every street. Square root of mean area per station gives nominal spacing, not actual resolution near street canyons or sources.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：都市面積 A=36 km²；感測站 N=16。公式 s=sqrt(A/N)，計算得 1.5 km nominal spacing。適用邊界：均勻平面方格的幾何近似，不是採樣密度或法定設站建議。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Urban area A=36 km²; number of sensors N=16. Formula s=sqrt(A/N) gives 1.5 km nominal spacing. Applicability: A geometric approximation to a uniform square grid, not a station-density or regulatory siting recommendation.
units.verify: 針對「地圖插值與代表範圍」，將站點疊在道路、地形與使用目的圖，檢查空間缺口及重複代表區。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Mapping interpolation and representation, Overlay stations on roads, terrain and measurement objectives and check gaps and redundant representation. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

Recalculation changes 1.5 to 1 km nominal spacing. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 漂移與定期再共置~Drift and repeat colocation
units.mechanism: 比較感測器老化前後的保留測試資料；維修或更換之後保留版本資訊以避免拼接偏差。 RMSE 先平方再平均開根號，同時反映偏差與散布，不是標準差的同義詞。~Compare held-out tests before and after ageing and retain versions after maintenance or replacement to avoid splicing bias. RMSE squares errors before averaging and taking the root; it includes bias and spread and is not synonymous with standard deviation.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：三個配對誤差 e=[2,-1,3] µg/m³。公式 RMSE=sqrt(mean(e²))，計算得 2.16025 µg/m³。適用邊界：配對樣本與相同單位；不由 RMSE 單獨判斷用途適合度。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Three paired errors e=[2,-1,3] µg/m³. Formula RMSE=sqrt(mean(e²)) gives 2.16025 µg/m³. Applicability: Paired samples in the same units; RMSE alone does not establish fitness for purpose.
units.verify: 針對「漂移與定期再共置」，與平均誤差、斜率及殘差圖一起報告，留出未擬合的資料評估。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Drift and repeat colocation, Report it with mean bias, slope and residual plots and evaluate on held-out data. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 訓練資料上的低 RMSE 可能只是過度擬合。 在「漂移與定期再共置」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Low training RMSE may reflect overfitting. Mark where this error can enter the Drift and repeat colocation flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: RMSE 永遠等於量測誤差的標準差。~RMSE always equals the standard deviation of measurement errors.
units.practice: 只把第三個誤差改為 6，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2.16025 變成 3.69685 µg/m³。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only the third error to 6, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 2.16025 to 3.69685 µg/m³. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 用途限制與公眾解讀~Fitness for purpose and public interpretation
units.mechanism: 發布數值同時提供時間窗、有效率和校正版本，說明此網路的研究用途，不能自動等同法定監測站。 完整率追蹤有效資料覆蓋；缺值可能集中在尖峰事件，不能只看比例。~Publish averaging intervals, completeness and calibration version with readings, explaining research purpose without equating the network automatically with regulatory stations. Completeness tracks valid coverage; gaps may cluster during peaks, so percentage alone is insufficient.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：應有時段 N=1440；有效時段 n=1320。公式 coverage=n/N*100，計算得 91.6667 %。適用邊界：明確時間格與有效性規則；本題不宣稱任何法規有效率門檻。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Expected intervals N=1440; valid intervals n=1320. Formula coverage=n/N*100 gives 91.6667 %. Applicability: Explicit interval grid and validity rules; no regulatory completeness threshold is claimed.
units.verify: 針對「用途限制與公眾解讀」，畫出缺值時間軸並保留校正、維護與通訊錯誤旗標，禁止把缺值填成零。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Fitness for purpose and public interpretation, Plot missing intervals with calibration, maintenance and communication flags; never replace missing values with zero. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 高污染時停機造成選擇性缺值，可偏低估平均污染。 在「用途限制與公眾解讀」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Outages during high pollution cause selective missingness and can bias the average downward. Mark where this error can enter the Fitness for purpose and public interpretation flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 缺測資料填成零不會影響污染平均值。~Replacing missing data with zero does not affect mean pollution.
units.practice: 只將 n 改成 1200，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 91.6667 變成 83.3333 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only valid intervals n to 1200, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 91.6667 to 83.3333 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.
